_comment: Copy to ~/.biomni-mcp/daemons.json (user-local, gitignored). One entry per Biomni account: name (matches the accounts.json biomni account name), cdp_port (the debug Chrome's --remote-debugging-port), broker_port (must match BIOMNI_API_BASE in the accounts.json entry), token_file (where the cookie is stored + served), chrome_profile (the debug Chrome --user-data-dir, already signed into Biomni). `chrome` optionally overrides the chrome.exe path. autostart.py reads this and brings up Chrome+broker+refresher per account.
